question: Should this PR remain the canonical Matrix fix, or should maintainers switch to or port the shared-sanitizer behavior from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99417?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same Matrix reasoning leak; this PR has stronger live Matrix send/read proof, while the newer branch carries broader mixed-text sanitizer coverage.

options.title: Port mixed sanitizer here
